Creepin’ it sweet this Halloween! 💜🕸️



We’re spinning up something SPOOK-tacular with @joyconeco and @mymochi! 👻



Ingredients:

 Joy Cake Cones

 Melted chocolate

 Cotton candy

 My/Mochi Cotton Candy Ice Cream

 6 small pieces of black licorice per spider

 2 candy eyes per spider



Instructions:

Dip the rim of a Joy Cake Cone into melted chocolate.



Add a fluffy layer of cotton candy to the top of the cone.



Place one My/Mochi Cotton Candy Ice Cream piece on top of the cotton candy.



Gently add 6 little licorice legs, 3 on each side of the mochi.



Attach 2 candy eyes with a tiny dab of melted chocolate to bring your spooky little spider to life!



Serve immediately and enjoy your BOO-tiful creation! 



Sweet, chewy, crunchy, and just the right amount of spooky! Would you take a bite of this adorable little spider?
